principles: Event records are canonical, immutable provenance of discrete physical state transitions.
Events must be emitted by an authorized law and valid preconditions; authoring a timestamp alone is not a trigger.
Seeded stochasticity can choose among physically eligible alternatives only under an authorized distribution/parameter authority.
Unknown eligibility remains unknown and cannot be treated as false or true for convenience.

event_types.RIFT_INITIATION: Starts only when authorized eligibility and trigger predicates are satisfied.
event_types.PLATE_SPLIT: Creates child plate identities and new boundary through explicit event geometry and lineage.
event_types.SUBDUCTION_INITIATION: Optional macro-state transition; no slab/mantle mechanics implied.
event_types.COLLISION_START: Requires governed contact/convergence and crust-pair semantics.
event_types.OROGENIC_EPISODE_START: Links authorized boundary process to vertical forcing; does not directly paint relief.
event_types.OROGENIC_EPISODE_END: Ends forcing only under bound termination/persistence law.
event_types.MAJOR_UPLIFT: Optional event summary of a law-derived forcing change.
event_types.MAJOR_SUBSIDENCE: Optional event summary of a law-derived forcing change.

event_lifecycle.preconditions: State and drivers satisfy law-defined eligibility.
event_lifecycle.trigger: Bound causal function of physical state/forcing; any stochastic component has explicit authorized distribution and seed.
event_lifecycle.realization: ARCANA defines semantic pre/post state; geometry solver resolves supplied topological operation.
event_lifecycle.validation: Check geometry, lineage, conservation/accounting where appropriate, and event provenance.
event_lifecycle.unknown: No event realization; preserve unknown state and report unresolved support.

plate_split_lineage.historical_identity: Parent remains queryable before split; child IDs are stable after split; no retroactive reassignment.

cha_interaction: A CHA transformation is applied only at its independently authorized event boundary between physical states. No tectonic, uplift, or geology effect is inferred when the CHA contract does not specify one.
no_event_is_not_implicit_persistence: Absence of an event does not authorize state persistence unless a time-valid law explicitly does so.
